# Media

The BlitzLLVM logo: an isometric cube (the 3D world) with a lightning bolt ("Blitz") on one side and a graph of nodes (the compiler's intermediate representation) on the other.

* `icon.svg`: the full logo as a square icon. The pixel-art bolt is an embedded PNG.
* `icon-small.svg`: the simplified logo for 16 to 32 pixels, where the grid and the big graph turn into noise.
* `cover.svg` and `cover.png`: the cover image of the itch.io page, 630x500.
* `banner.png`: the banner of the itch.io page, 960x320, with the logo and two screenshots of the forest example (`benchmarks/images`).
* `itch-description.html` and `itch-tagline.txt`: the text of the itch.io page (itch drops parts of the page when its editor is reloaded, so the text is kept here). The tagline is at most 100 characters.
* `windows/blitzllvm.ico`: 16, 24, 32 (from `icon-small.svg`) and 48, 64, 128, 256 pixels (from `icon.svg`), used by the Windows tools and the installer.

The logo is a stylized cube, bolt and graph. It is not the LLVM logo and does not use it.
